# Project Overview

Study Site: Research was split between two different zones within the greater Yasuni Biosphere Reserve. Tiputini Biodiversity Station (TBS) served as the faunally intact site, whereas Yasuni Research Station (YRS) served as the defaunated site. Both sites are situated along the Tiputini River within the province of Orellana, Ecuador. TBS, approximately 45 km east of YRS, is only accessible by boat. YRS is along the Maxus Oil Road, and is less integrated into the Amazonian ecosystem. Additionally, unsustainable hunting activities by the indigenous communities have been prominent in the surrounding region at YRS for multiple decades, as noted from 2014. This is thought to be the root cause of defaunation in this zone. 

	I transferred between the two research stations every two weeks, starting my first rotation at TBS on June 10. Time at each station was spent working on 3 separate projects: my herpetofauna surveys, frugivory surveys, and an overarching seed enemy and dispersal project. 

	The rainy season in Northeastern Ecuador is at its peak between March and July. I conducted my study between the months of June and August, 2024. The average high temperature for June in this region is 85.66° F, with the average low of 70.05° F. July has an average high temperature of 86.29° F and an average low of 69.13° F. August has an average high temperature of 91.35° F and an average low of 69.60° F. June receives 143mm of precipitation on average each year, whereas July receives 99.69mm and August receives 77.55mm. (https://weatherandclimate.com/ecuador/orellana/boca-tiputini) 
Put project description here (field sites, time frame of collection,sampling scheme, type of data (eg. species ID,temp, etc.) )

Surveys: Herpetofauna were sampled using visual surveys on foot by two surveyors/night. Trail systems at each site served as the sampling paths. The surveys were repeated around 6 times on each rotation while in the field, and resampled on the second rotations. The surveys typically began around 20:00-20:30 and lasted until 23:00-00:00 CST. At each site, habitat matches were compared and assessed and trails through that habitat were consistently walked. Two different types of habitat, Terra Firma (uplands) and Varzea (flooded forest) were surveyed on the herp nocturnal walks. In addition to this, two significant bodies of water were also surveyed at each site, primarily consisting of oxbow lakes with one year-round large pond. 

	Surveyors used FENIX HM60R headlamps while conducting night surveys. They carefully examined all surrounding habitat, including understory trees, shrubs, vines, water bodies, forest floor, and middle-canopy. Amphibians of the order Anura gave off reflective eyeshine and were easier to sample for, whereas members of Squamata did not. More information about this will be within the discussion section. Effort hours will be calculated based on survey time length and number of surveyors. 

	Additionally, environmental information was taken throughout the course of each survey. Temperature and humidity data was collected with a Mengshen meter in 30 minute intervals on surveys. Understory vegetation density was also measured every 15 minutes along each trail. A 1.5m PVC pipe was randomly placed upright just off the right side of the trail at each measuring point, and the number of leaves making contact with the pipe was counted. 

	Weather and wind were noted before each survey in four nominal categories, with weather either being “clear, partly cloudy, cloudy, rainy” and wind being “no wind, felt on face, branches move, trees move”. I also accounted for precipitation that had already occurred in 6-hour blocks as “time window of last rain event”. 

	Once an animal was found, the first step of the protocol was to note what time of night the find occurred. After this, the temperature and humidity was once again collected. A rangefinder was used to estimate the perpendicular distance of each animal from the trail. A GPS was used to mark and log the coordinates of each animal found. Animals were given a two-letter code based on the Order and Suborder followed by a number, indicating its position of being found. For example, the code of the 9th snake found of the season would be SK09. Species found were also identified to the lowest taxonomic level in the field, and photographs of individuals were taken both to get positive IDs later in the lab when not possible in the field, but also to avoid counting re-captures.

	Snakes found during non-survey times were also recorded. These individuals were split into one of two categories of detection. The first is an “Opportunistic Encounter” (OE), which is any snake that was found by me while out working on other non-herpetofauna projects in the field. The other type of detection is the Third Party Encounter (TPE). This was any snake that was found by other research groups during my rotations at each station, identified to lowest possible taxonomy. The same data was taken for these individuals. GPS coordinates, time of detection, trail, observer, estimation of distance from trail, and habitat type. Because the third-party observers often didn’t have access to the climate data logger, this information was retrieved later on from each station’s respective weather tower data, based on the time of detection. 

Snakes were given a classification as to whether they were small mammal consumers or not. Information on this was retrieved from literature such as online publications, the book Reptiles and Amphibians of the Amazon by R.D. and Patricia Bartlett, and the expert field book Reptiles of Ecuador. 

# Read in and prep data

## Read in

This data was cleaned some in initial steps in 2024-2026 (see archived code). Note that temp and humidity data was removed for 4 surveys at YRS that took place after July 11, 2025, during which the team lost confidence in the data collection instrument. 

```{r data read in}
all_surv_records <- read.csv("Data/all_survey_records_aug2026.csv")
# a record of every segment surveyed, afternoon and night, with length and time

amph_lz <- read.csv("Data/amph_lz_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# cleaned amphibian and lizard data - a record of every individual found, when, and what segment
# make sure there are no duplicates...
amph_lz <- amph_lz %>%
  distinct(Animal_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # evidently there was 1

# I cleaned frogs and added a tadpole phase column, now they are a sep df
frogs_df <- read.csv("frogs.csv")
frogs_df$Start_Date <- mdy(frogs_df$Start_Date)
# remove the morning survey
frogs_df <- frogs_df %>% filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

effort <- read.csv("Data/effort_aug2026.csv")
# Date, effort hours, segment length

env_2025 <- read.csv("Data/env_2025_cleaned.csv", encoding = "latin1")
# 2025 env data

env_24_25_nights <- read.csv("Data/env_24_25_nights_aug2026.csv")
# night time survey environmental data both years

small.mamms.df <- read.csv("Data/small_mammals_aug2026.csv")
# records of small mammals spotted during surveys

snakes.master <- read.csv("Data/snakes_master_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# all snake records

snakes.sur <- read.csv("Data/snake_surveys_cleaned_aug2026.csv")
# all the snake survey records, cleaned
# this version of snakes.sur has those two duplicates (SK04, 05) removed

```


# Sampling Effort Summaries

```{r mean efforts}

# mean and sd search effort per station per survey type
all_surv_records %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(mean_search_time_hrs = mean(Effort_hrs),
            sd = sd(Effort_hrs))

# mean and sd meters searched per station per survey type
temp <-all_surv_records %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(total_meters_surveyed = sum(Seg_dist_m))

temp %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(mean_length = mean(total_meters_surveyed),
            sd_length = sd(total_meters_surveyed))

rm(temp)

all_surv_records %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type) %>%
  summarize(cumulative_m = sum(Seg_dist_m),
            cumulative_surveys = n_distinct(Start_Date_Start_Time))

```

# Small Mammals

## small mammal model 

```{r small mammal model}

smam.mod1 <- glmmTMB(smamm.500m ~ Station + (1|Parent_Trail_LongName), data = small.mamms.df, family = tweedie(link = "log"))

sim <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = smam.mod1, plot = T)

summary(smam.mod1) # great, can report this

testDispersion(smam.mod1, plot = F)
testZeroInflation(smam.mod1, plot = F)

Anova(smam.mod1)
rm(sim, smam.mod1)
```

## small mammal summary data

```{r small mammal summs}

# make summary of mean and SE and keep for plotting later
small.mamms.summ <- small.mamms.df %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(smamm.500m),
            sd = sd(smamm.500m),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# also look at raw mammal counts
sum(small.mamms.df$Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted[small.mamms.df$Station == "YRS"])

sum(small.mamms.df$Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted[small.mamms.df$Station == "TBS"])

# report mean and sd of n encountered per survey at each station:

env_24_25_nights %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  summarise(mean_detections_per_survey = mean(Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted),
            standard_deviation = sd(Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted))

# make data object
small.mamms.df$Start_Date<- ymd(small.mamms.df$Start_Date)

# look per year
small.mamms.df$Year<- factor(format(small.mamms.df$Start_Date, "%Y"))

# summarize per year
small.mamms.summ.yr <- small.mamms.df %>%
  group_by(Station, Year) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(smamm.500m),
            sd = sd(smamm.500m),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

```

## small mammal plot

```{r small mammal plot}
# specify the dodge width for points
spec_dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

small.mammal.plot <- ggplot(small.mamms.summ, aes(x = Station, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(data = small.mamms.df, aes(x = Station, y = smamm.500m), color = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge()) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, width = 0.1)) +
  geom_point(position = spec_dodge) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Unhunted", "Hunted")) + labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) + ylab("Individuals per 500m") + labs(title = "Small mammal detection rates") 

small.mammal.plot

# per year
small.mammal.plot.yearly <- ggplot(small.mamms.summ.yr, aes(x = Station, y = mean, shape = Year)) +
  geom_point(data = small.mamms.df, aes(x = Station, y = smamm.500m, shape = Year), color = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se, width = 0.1), position = spec_dodge) +
  geom_point(position = spec_dodge) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Unhunted", "Hunted")) + labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) + ylab("Individuals per 500m") + labs(title = "Small mammal detection rates") 

small.mammal.plot.yearly
# this should be (a) in main text figure 2, top row (will go with frog and lizard detection rate plots, which are created lower in the script, all of which should go on the top row in 3 columns. Snakes will go in row 2 underneath.)

```

# Prep frog and lizard data

## Frogs

```{r frogs}

# survey distance data
survey_distance <- all_surv_records %>%
group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
reframe(survey_length_m = sum(Seg_dist_m)) %>%
  distinct()

survey_distance$Start_Date<- ymd(survey_distance$Start_Date)

surveys_without_frogs <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Start_Date %in% (setdiff(survey_distance$Start_Date, frogs_df$Start_Date))) %>%
  mutate(n = 0)

# add survey lengths to frog df
frogs_df<- left_join(frogs_df, survey_distance, by = c("Station", "Start_Date", "Survey_Type"))

# tallies
frogs_tallied <- frogs_df %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type, survey_length_m) %>% tally()

# add instances without frogs found
frogs_tallied <- rbind(frogs_tallied, surveys_without_frogs)

rm(surveys_without_frogs)

frogs_tallied$n_500m <-(frogs_tallied$n/frogs_tallied$survey_length_m)*500
```

### Frog summary

```{r frog summary data}

# get summary data overall (regardless of year)
frog.summ <- frogs_tallied %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  reframe(mean = mean(n_500m),
           sd = sd(n_500m),
           sample_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(sample_size))

# create year column
frogs_tallied$Year <- factor(format(frogs_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

# get summary data per year
frog.summ.yr <- frogs_tallied %>%
  group_by(Station, Year) %>%
reframe(mean = mean(n_500m),
           sd = sd(n_500m),
           sample_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(sample_size))

```

## Lizards

```{r lizards}
liz_df <- amph_lz %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning") %>%
  filter(Gross_ID == "Lizard")

liz_df$Start_Date <- ymd(liz_df$Date)

surveys_without_liz <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Start_Date %in% (setdiff(survey_distance$Start_Date, liz_df$Start_Date))) %>%
  mutate(n = 0)

# add survey lengths to frog df
liz_df <- liz_df %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station, Survey_Type, Animal_ID)

liz_df<- left_join(liz_df, survey_distance, by = c("Station", "Start_Date", "Survey_Type"))

# tallies
liz_tallied <- liz_df %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type, survey_length_m) %>% tally()

# add instances without frogs found
liz_tallied <- rbind(liz_tallied, surveys_without_liz)

rm(surveys_without_liz)

# get n per 500m
liz_tallied$n_500m <-(liz_tallied$n/liz_tallied$survey_length_m)*500
```

# Snakes

## Snakes pooled

```{r prep tot snake data}

# make one data frame of only the snake records (remove NAs where no snakes were found) 
surveys_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% # if snake ID is na, there were no snakes found that survey
  select(Start_Date, Station)

# dates
surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date)

# likewise, make one df of only cases where no snakes were found and keep relevant columns with it
surveys_without_snakes <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night" & !Start_Date %in% surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date) %>%
select(-Survey_Type)

# add n
surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

# add survey length data to surveys with snakes
# isolate distance info for nighttime surveys
survey_distance_nights <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(-Survey_Type) %>%
  distinct()
# now add
surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

# add a n snakes column to surveys with snakes
surveys_with_snakes$n_snakes <-1

surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

# rbind to add the surveys without snakes
all_surveys_data <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes, surveys_with_snakes)

# tally
all_snakes_tallied <- all_surveys_data %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, survey_length_m) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = sum(n_snakes))
# detection rate

all_snakes_tallied$n_500m <- 500*(all_snakes_tallied$n_snakes/all_snakes_tallied$survey_length_m)

# clean
rm(all_surveys_data, surveys_with_snakes, surveys_without_snakes)
```

## By Diet Type

### Three diet types

```{r prep three guild snake df}

# make one data frame of only the snake records (remove NAs where no snakes were found) 
surveys_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% # if snake ID is na, there were no snakes found that survey
  select(Start_Date, Station, Snake_ID, Diet_Type_3categories)

length(unique(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date))
# 46 surveys with snakes

# dates
surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date)

# add survey length data to surveys with snakes
# isolate distance info for nighttime surveys
survey_distance_nights <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(-Survey_Type) %>%
  distinct()

# now add
surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

# count up snakes
surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, survey_length_m, Diet_Type_3categories) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n())

# pivot wider
surveys_with_snakes_wide <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Diet_Type_3categories,
              values_from = n_snakes,
              values_fill = 0)

# now that we have 0s for cases where a certain guild wasn't found on a survey, collapse back with pivot longer

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(no_mammals, mixed, mostly_mammals),
               names_to = "diet_type",
               values_to = "n_snakes")

surveys_without_snakes <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night" & !Start_Date %in% surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date) %>%
select(-Survey_Type)

# add n
surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

# add diet type
surveys_without_snakes_nomamms <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_nomamms$diet_type <-"no_mammals"

surveys_without_snakes_mixed <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_mixed$diet_type<- "mixed"

surveys_without_snakes_mostlymamms <- surveys_without_snakes

surveys_without_snakes_mostlymamms$diet_type <- "mostly_mammals"

surveys_without_snakes_compelete <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_mixed, surveys_without_snakes_mostlymamms, surveys_without_snakes_nomamms)

# add zero survey instances to surveys with snakes
three_guilds_tallied <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_with_snakes)

three_guilds_tallied$n_500m <- 500*(three_guilds_tallied$n_snakes/three_guilds_tallied$survey_length_m)

# add year column
three_guilds_tallied$Year <- factor(format(three_guilds_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

rm(surveys_with_snakes, surveys_with_snakes_wide, surveys_without_snakes, surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_without_snakes_mixed, surveys_without_snakes_mostlymamms, surveys_without_snakes_nomamms)
```

#### Three diet types summary

```{r three diet type summ}
# get summary data overall (regardless of year)
snake.3guild.summ <- three_guilds_tallied %>%
  group_by(Station, diet_type) %>%
  reframe(mean = mean(n_500m),
           sd = sd(n_500m),
           sample_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(sample_size))

# get summary data per year
snake.3guild.summ.yr <- three_guilds_tallied %>%
  group_by(Station, diet_type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean = mean(n_500m),
           sd = sd(n_500m),
           sample_size = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(sample_size))
```

### Two diet types

```{r prep two guild snake df}

# same as above - see those annotations
surveys_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% 
  select(Start_Date, Station, Snake_ID, Diet_Type)

surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date)

survey_distance_nights <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(-Survey_Type) %>%
  distinct()

surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, survey_length_m, Diet_Type) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n())

surveys_with_snakes_wide <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Diet_Type,
              values_from = n_snakes,
              values_fill = 0)

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(no_mammals, consumes_mammals),
               names_to = "Diet_Type",
               values_to = "n_snakes")

surveys_without_snakes <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night" & !Start_Date %in% surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date) %>%
select(-Survey_Type)

# add n
surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

# add diet type
surveys_without_snakes_nomamms <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_nomamms$Diet_Type <-"no_mammals"

surveys_without_snakes_mamms <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_mamms$Diet_Type<- "consumes_mammals"

surveys_without_snakes_compelete <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_mamms, surveys_without_snakes_nomamms)

two_guilds_tallied <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_with_snakes)

two_guilds_tallied$n_500m <- 500*(two_guilds_tallied$n_snakes/two_guilds_tallied$survey_length_m)

two_guilds_tallied$Year <- factor(format(two_guilds_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

# remove one outlier
two_guilds_tallied <- two_guilds_tallied[-44,]

rm(surveys_with_snakes, surveys_with_snakes_wide, surveys_without_snakes, surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_without_snakes_mamms, surveys_without_snakes_nomamms)
```

### Families Colubridae vs Boidae

```{r prep snake fam df}

# same general process as above - see annotations there
surveys_with_snakes <- snakes.sur %>% filter(!is.na(Snake_ID)) %>% 
  select(Start_Date, Station, Snake_ID, Family)

surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date <- mdy(surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date)

survey_distance_nights <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  select(-Survey_Type) %>%
  distinct()

surveys_with_snakes <- left_join(surveys_with_snakes, survey_distance_nights)

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, survey_length_m, Family) %>%
  reframe(n_snakes = n())

surveys_with_snakes_wide <- surveys_with_snakes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Family,
              values_from = n_snakes,
              values_fill = 0)

surveys_with_snakes <- surveys_with_snakes_wide %>%
  select(-Viperidae, -Elapidae) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Colubridae, Boidae),
               names_to = "Family",
               values_to = "n_snakes")

surveys_without_snakes <- survey_distance %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night" & !Start_Date %in% surveys_with_snakes$Start_Date) %>%
select(-Survey_Type)

# add n
surveys_without_snakes$n_snakes <-0

# add Family
surveys_without_snakes_colubridae <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_colubridae$Family <-"Colubridae"

surveys_without_snakes_boidae <- surveys_without_snakes
surveys_without_snakes_boidae$Family<- "Boidae"

surveys_without_snakes_compelete <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_boidae, surveys_without_snakes_colubridae)

families_tallied <- rbind(surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_with_snakes)

families_tallied$n_500m <- 500*(families_tallied$n_snakes/families_tallied$survey_length_m)

families_tallied$Year <- factor(format(families_tallied$Start_Date, "%Y"))

rm(surveys_with_snakes, surveys_with_snakes_wide, surveys_without_snakes, surveys_without_snakes_compelete, surveys_without_snakes_boidae, surveys_without_snakes_colubridae)
```

# Env data

Format the humidity and understory and the temp data and then get means and add them to the herp dfs

```{r prep env and join to obs dfs}

humidity_long <- env_2025 %>%
  select(Date, Station, Survey_Type, 
         Humidity_1:Humidity_8, Humidity_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Humidity_1:Humidity_Final,
               values_to = "Humidity", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs
humidity_long <- humidity_long %>%
  na.omit()

# fix date
humidity_long$Start_Date <- mdy(humidity_long$Date)

humidity_long <- humidity_long %>%
  select(-Date)
# there are 3 humidity readings that are very low (<70) and are all the 1 (or 2nd) reading of the night - this could be error, and our sampling intensity is robust enough for us to not worry about influencing results by removing these outliers. 

#humidity_long <- humidity_long %>%
 # filter(Humidity > 70)

# repeat with temp
temp_long <- env_2025 %>%
  select(Date, Station, Survey_Type, 
         Temperature_1:Temperature_8, Temperature_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Temperature_1:Temperature_Final,
               values_to = "Temperature", names_repair = "unique")

# remove NAs
temp_long <- temp_long %>%
  na.omit()

# date
temp_long$Start_Date <- mdy(temp_long$Date)
temp_long <- temp_long %>%
  select(-Date)

# understory
understory_long <- env_2025 %>%
  select(Date, Station, Survey_Type, 
         Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_13, Understory_Density_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_Final,
               values_to = "Understory", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs
understory_long <- understory_long %>%
  na.omit()

# fix date
understory_long$Start_Date <- mdy(understory_long$Date)
understory_long <- understory_long %>%
  select(-Date)

# 2024 data

# pull out 2024 year only
env_24_25_nights$Start_Date <- ymd(env_24_25_nights$Start_Date)
env_24_25_nights$Year<- factor(format(env_24_25_nights$Start_Date, "%Y"))
  
env_2024 <- env_24_25_nights %>%
  filter(Year == "2024")

# humidity - 2024 - pivot

# simplify
env_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(-Effort_hrs, -Notes, -Number_of_Small_Mammals_Spotted, -Number_of_Water_Bodies_Spotted, -Surveyors, -Searching_Time, -Meters, -Order, -Survey_Start_Time, -Survey_End_Time)

humidity_long_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station,
         Humidity_1:Humidity_8, Humidity_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Humidity_1:Humidity_Final,
               values_to = "Humidity", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs

humidity_long_2024 <- humidity_long_2024 %>%
  na.omit()

# repeat with temp
temperature_long_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station,
         Temperature_1:Temperature_8, Temperature_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Temperature_1:Temperature_Final,
               values_to = "Temperature", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs

temperature_long_2024 <- temperature_long_2024 %>%
  na.omit()

# repeat with understory
understory_long_2024 <- env_2024 %>%
  select(Start_Date, Station,
         Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_13, Understory_Density_Final) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "Measurement",
               cols = Understory_Density_1:Understory_Density_Final,
               values_to = "Understory", names_repair = "unique")
# remove NAs

understory_long_2024 <- understory_long_2024 %>%
  na.omit()

# join
# add survey type column to 2024 env data
humidity_long_2024$Survey_Type <-"Night"
temperature_long_2024$Survey_Type <-"Night"
understory_long_2024$Survey_Type <-"Night"

humidity_all <- rbind(humidity_long, humidity_long_2024)
temperature_all <- rbind(temp_long, temperature_long_2024)
understory_all <-rbind(understory_long, understory_long_2024)

# get means
humidity_means <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(Humidity > 73) %>% # two afternoon survey outliers
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  reframe(mean_relative_humidity = mean(Humidity))

temperature_means <- temperature_all %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  reframe(mean_temp_F = mean(Temperature))

understory_means <- understory_all %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date, Survey_Type) %>%
  reframe(mean_understory_leaves = mean(Understory))

# repeat with only the night time surveys for the snake data

humidity_means_night <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date) %>%
  reframe(mean_humidity = mean(Humidity))

temperature_means_night <- temperature_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type == "Night") %>%
  group_by(Station, Start_Date) %>%
  reframe(mean_temp_F = mean(Temperature))


# center and scale
humidity_means$humidity_scaled <-scale(humidity_means$mean_relative_humidity)

temperature_means$temp_scaled <-scale(temperature_means$mean_temp_F)

# and for snake survey data only
humidity_means_night$humidity_scaled <-scale(humidity_means_night$mean_humidity)

temperature_means_night$temp_scaled <-scale(temperature_means_night$mean_temp_F)

# understory not included in models so not bothering to center and scale here
```

## Add Env to dfs
```{r add env to dfs}

frogs_tallied <- left_join(frogs_tallied, humidity_means)
frogs_tallied <- left_join(frogs_tallied, temperature_means)

liz_tallied <- left_join(liz_tallied, humidity_means)
liz_tallied <- left_join(liz_tallied, temperature_means)

all_snakes_tallied <-left_join(all_snakes_tallied, humidity_means_night)
all_snakes_tallied <- left_join(all_snakes_tallied, temperature_means_night)

three_guilds_tallied <- left_join(three_guilds_tallied, humidity_means_night)
three_guilds_tallied <- left_join(three_guilds_tallied, temperature_means_night)

two_guilds_tallied <- left_join(two_guilds_tallied, humidity_means_night)
two_guilds_tallied <- left_join(two_guilds_tallied, temperature_means_night)
```


```{r summarize hum and temp and und}

humidity_all$Year <- factor(format(humidity_all$Start_Date, "%Y"))

temperature_all$Year <- factor(format(temperature_all$Start_Date, "%Y"))

understory_all$Year <- factor(format(understory_all$Start_Date, "%Y"))


humidity_all <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

humidity_summary_yr_survey_type <- humidity_all %>%
  filter(!(Year==2024 & Survey_Type == "Afternoon")) %>%
  filter(!(Survey_Type == "Morning")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean_humidity = mean(Humidity),
            sd = sd(Humidity),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# temperature
temperature_all <- temperature_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

temperature_summary_yr_survey_type <- temperature_all %>%
  filter(!(Year==2024 & Survey_Type == "Afternoon")) %>%
  filter(!(Survey_Type == "Morning")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean_temperature = mean(Temperature),
            sd = sd(Temperature),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# clean
rm(temperature_all, temp_long, humidity_all, humidity_long, humidity_long_2024, temperature_long_2024)

# understory
understory_all <- understory_all %>%
  filter(Survey_Type != "Morning")

understory_summary_yr_survey_type <- understory_all %>%
  filter(!(Year==2024 & Survey_Type == "Afternoon")) %>%
  filter(!(Survey_Type == "Morning")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Survey_Type, Year) %>%
  reframe(mean_understory = mean(Understory),
            sd = sd(Understory),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

understory_summary <- understory_all %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  reframe(mean_understory = mean(Understory),
            sd = sd(Understory),
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# clean
rm(understory_all, understory_summary_yr_survey_type, understory_summary)
```

# Frogs

## Frog models

```{r frog det rate model comparison, warning = FALSE}

# remove instances where some env vars are NA
frogs_tallied <- frogs_tallied %>%
  na.omit()

# null
frog.null <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ 1, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())

summary(frog.null)
# AIC 245.9

# survey type
frog.survtype <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())

summary(frog.survtype)
# AIC 243.1 better

# hunting
frog.survtype.hunt <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Station + Survey_Type, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.hunt)
# 244.9 worse

# year
frog.survtype.year <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type + Year, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.year)

# 245.0 worse

# humidity
frog.survtype.humidity <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type + humidity_scaled, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.humidity)
# AIC 241.6 significantly better fit

# temperature

frog.survtype.humidity.temperature <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type + humidity_scaled + temp_scaled, data = frogs_tallied, family = tweedie())
summary(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature)
# AIC 238.8 significantly better fit

frog_mod_names <- c("frog.null", "frog.survtype", "frog.survtype.hunt", "frog.survtype.year", "frog.survtype.humidity", "frog.survtype.humidity.temperature")

# compare
aictab(cand.set = list(frog.null, frog.survtype, frog.survtype.hunt, frog.survtype.year, frog.survtype.humidity, frog.survtype.humidity.temperature), modnames = frog_mod_names)

# best fit model results:
Anova(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature) # temp and humidity both have significant effects on frog detection rates
summary(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature)

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = frog.survtype.humidity.temperature, plot = T) # passes
testZeroInflation(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature) # passes
testDispersion(frog.survtype.humidity.temperature) # passes

```

# Lizards

## Lizard models

```{r liz det rate model comparison, warning = FALSE}
# there are some outliers, and this trend doesn't make sense so I'm removing them
liz_tallied <- liz_tallied %>%
  na.omit()

liz_tallied.no.outlier <- liz_tallied %>%
  filter(mean_temp_F > 70)

liz_tallied.no.outlier <- liz_tallied %>%
  filter(n_500m < 1.7)

# null
liz.null <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ 1, data = liz_tallied.no.outlier, family = tweedie())

summary(liz.null)

# survey type
liz.survtype <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Survey_Type, data = liz_tallied.no.outlier, family = tweedie())

summary(liz.survtype)

# hunting
liz.hunt <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Station, data = liz_tallied.no.outlier, family = tweedie())
summary(liz.hunt)
# better - keep in subsequent models

# year
liz.hunt.year <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Station + Year, data = liz_tallied.no.outlier, family = tweedie())
summary(liz.hunt.year)

# humidity
liz.hunt.humidity <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Station + humidity_scaled, data = liz_tallied.no.outlier, family = tweedie())

summary(liz.hunt.humidity) # worse

# temperature
liz.hunt.temperature <- glmmTMB(n_500m ~ Station + temp_scaled, data = liz_tallied.no.outlier, family = tweedie())
summary(liz.hunt.temperature)

liz_mod_names <- c("liz.null", "liz.hunt", "liz.hunt.year", "liz.hunt.humidity", "liz.hunt.temperature")

# compare
aictab(cand.set = list(liz.null, liz.hunt, liz.hunt.year, liz.hunt.humidity, liz.hunt.temperature), modnames = liz_mod_names)

# best fit model results:
Anova(liz.hunt)
summary(liz.hunt)

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = liz.hunt, plot = T) # passes
testZeroInflation(liz.hunt) # passes
testDispersion(liz.hunt) # passes

```

# Snakes

## Pooled

```{r models snakes pooled}
# remove NA cases for env vars
all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit <- all_snakes_tallied %>%
  na.omit

# null
# 1
n_snake.null <- glmmTMB(all_snakes_tallied ~ 1 + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)
                        
summary(n_snake.null)
#AIC 208.9

simulateResiduals(fittedModel = n_snake.null, plot = T) # passes
testZeroInflation(n_snake.null) # passes
testDispersion(n_snake.null) # passes

# Year
n_snake.yr <- glmmTMB(all_snakes_tallied ~ Year + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)
                        
summary(n_snake.yr)
# AIC 208.8, basically the same

# Hunting status (station)
n_snake.hunt <-glmmTMB(all_snakes_tallied ~ Station + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(n_snake.hunt)
# AIC 210.7 worse

# humidity
n_snake.hum <-glmmTMB(all_snakes_tallied ~ humidity_scaled + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(n_snake.hum) #209.5 not better than null

# temp
n_snake.temp <-glmmTMB(all_snakes_tallied ~ temp_scaled + offset(log(survey_length_m)), data = all_snakes_tallied.NA.omit, family = nbinom2)

summary(n_snake.temp) # 209.7 not better than null

snake_overall_mod_names <- c("n_snake.null", "n_snake.yr", "n_snake.hunt", "n_snake.hum", "n_snake.temp")  

# compare
aictab(cand.set = list(n_snake.null, n_snake.yr, n_snake.hunt, n_snake.hum, n_snake.temp), modnames = snake_overall_mod_names)

# null is best fit
summary(n_snake.null)
```
